new_result.label: prop:ordinary-topology-gauge-failure
new_result.hypotheses: Compact connected curve, positive smooth background of area one, nonconstant smooth F with theta+ddcF positive.
new_result.conclusion: Paired background/obstacle transport is exact. With zero obstacles fixed, every nonconstant smooth gauge between positive curve backgrounds of equal area is discontinuous in both directions, already in a positive-mass cutoff. The complete polar-variation metric remains gauge invariant after ordinary projection.
new_result.proof: Approximate the smooth area measure weakly by nonatomic polar probabilities. Their scaled Green potentials converge to zero in the zero-obstacle uniformity. Polar order forces obstacle-F envelope curvature to dominate these scaled probabilities; convergence to F would contradict theta+ddcF >= c theta. Reverse the gauge to obtain incomparability.
new_result.limits: Constant gauges are excluded. The positive cutoff depends on the gauge and the choice of c. No higher-dimensional or all-obstacle completeness assertion is made.
